headline: Google Analytics is set up (FOUNDER Beauty · G-YP5SS23BXF) and goes live on the site with your next push. To count sales too, Shopify needs the same property connected; that's your one click below.

waitingOnYou.question: Connect Google Analytics inside Shopify: let the team open Shopify's Google & YouTube app and link it to the FOUNDER Beauty property (you approve Google's permission screen).
waitingOnYou.why: The site now reports visits. Purchases happen in Shopify checkout, so without this link, sales never reach Analytics and you can't see which page, post or campaign earned them.
waitingOnYou.answerFormat: 'Go ahead' (the team asks again before any permission screen), or 'I'll do it'.

waitingOnYou.question: Add one DNS record at GoDaddy: type CNAME, name 'checkout', value 'shops.myshopify.com'.
waitingOnYou.why: That moves checkout off founderbeauty.myshopify.com onto checkout.founderbeauty.co. Once the record exists, the team connects it in Shopify. One thing to know: Shopify uses its primary domain for checkout and for the order emails, so the team will set it up so the myshopify address keeps working and nothing on founderbeauty.co changes.
waitingOnYou.answerFormat: 'Done' (the team checks it), or 'walk me through it'.

waitingOnYou.question: Which postal address can go in the footer of marketing emails? A PO box is fine.
waitingOnYou.why: US law (CAN-SPAM) requires a physical address in marketing email. The welcome email is missing one.

waitingOnYou.question: Make the night ground the official canvas in Brand Board v2.15, or go back to Cream-first with dark anchors?
waitingOnYou.why: The Board says Cream; the site has been dark since your 27 Aug direction. The team is working from two systems until one is chosen.

waitingOnYou.question: One shop for both lines, labelled 'LALALOCA Serums' and 'The FOUNDER Collection' everywhere? And which line gets the main home button?
waitingOnYou.why: 'Shop' is titled for LALALOCA and shows 3 of 8 products. This reopens your 11 Sept naming revert now that two lines are live.
waitingOnYou.answerFormat: 'Yes, one shop', plus which line leads.

waitingOnYou.question: Is Hold the Room the 'where to begin' product?
waitingOnYou.why: Eight products and no obvious first purchase. One anchor makes the first order easier.

waitingOnYou.question: Which sets, at what prices? Proposed at full price: Serum + Hold the Room ($74), the full five-piece routine ($194).
waitingOnYou.why: Sets raise order value without discounting. Holiday gifting is the next moment.

waitingOnYou.question: Approve the welcome and after-purchase emails and a reviews app (no incentives). What does 'first through the door' actually give the Founding List?
waitingOnYou.why: The list promises access but nothing backs it yet. Proposed: 48-hour early entry to each release or set by private link.
waitingOnYou.answerFormat: 'Draft them for me to read', plus your early-entry choice.

waitingOnYou.question: Approve a third optional consent (photography and casting) and a signed per-use agreement for FOUND HER women.
waitingOnYou.why: This is how FOUND HER women can properly become the faces of FOUNDER. You set the terms: length, fee or gift, and whether any styling is ever allowed.

waitingOnYou.question: Did Aly approve the composited portrait (her face, generated outfit and room) as well as her text? Is founder-collection-door.webp a photo of you or a restyle?
waitingOnYou.why: Written records protect you and her. The charter promises no composite women.

waitingOnYou.question: Keep 'just under one million dollars in its first year' (Our Story and your FOUND HER profile)?
waitingOnYou.why: The Etsy export shows $724,850 in the first twelve months. Keep it if other channels close the gap (and keep the receipts). Otherwise: '$725K in its first twelve months; more than 35,000 orders over its life.'

waitingOnYou.question: Send what you have: serum ingredient lists, the source for '8-layer', ECOCERT certificates plus written permission to use them under FOUNDER, the dermatological test report, Clean Break's pH.
waitingOnYou.why: Ingredient and certification claims need paperwork on file.
waitingOnYou.answerFormat: Files, or 'ask Selfnamed for me' (draft only).

waitingOnYou.question: Approve a shorter home page (about 8 phone screens instead of 15), and decide whether the door overlay shows on phones.
waitingOnYou.why: Restraint deepens the mystery and gets her to the products sooner. The team will show you a preview first.

waitingOnYou.question: The first real shoot: budget, photographer, date, and you on camera for the threshold and direct-gaze frames.
waitingOnYou.why: Real women make the house human. The team has the shot list ready.

waitingOnYou.question: Three smaller ones: align the Terms wording with the certification claims; keep only Salon events that have dates; approve invitation-only referral terms and founder-story PR when drafted.
waitingOnYou.why: Each is a public commitment or legal text.

decided.question: When do the five FOUNDER Collection products ship?
decided.answer: October 12. The site, schema and Merchant feed now say 'Ships October 12' (one switch in the code), and Shopify carries the same badge; two Shopify descriptions are being corrected. Serums still ship in one business day. Orders that include Collection pieces are described as shipping on the 12th.

Checkout changes

decided.answer: The Cowork FOUNDER team. Other agents propose; changes go through this team's build, check and log routine.

decided.answer: Recorded as approved on 30 Sept (in the site's profile data).

decided.question: Is the House Trio pre-packed or made from single serums?
decided.answer: Made from singles. Done 1 Oct: the trio is now a Shopify bundle of Thirst Trap + C Me Glow + Bounce Back, so it sells from their stock (74 today, set by Bounce Back) instead of a separate 149. Price stays $98, checked on a live checkout. Checkout and the packing slip now list the three serums under the trio.

decided.question: Is order #1001 (6 Aug) a test?
decided.answer: A test. You cancel or archive it in Shopify admin; the team doesn't touch orders.

decided.question: Clean Shopify titles and tags?
decided.answer: 'Change them, I trust you.' Done 1 Oct: all nine titles now read NAME · what it is · line · size (e.g. 'THIRST TRAP 8-Layer Hyaluronic Acid Serum · LALALOCA · 50 ml'). Claims-risk tags removed from Bounce Back (anti-aging, wrinkle, tightening, lifting, firming…) and 'the_closer' replaced by 'the_poker_face'. Handles, prices, descriptions and images unchanged.

decided.question: Google Analytics: your G-ID or set it up for you?
decided.answer: Set it up for me. Done 1 Oct: Google Analytics account 'FOUNDER Beauty', property 'founderbeauty.co' (New York time to match Shopify, USD), web stream 'FOUNDER website', ID G-YP5SS23BXF. Terms accepted with your OK. Data sharing: Google products & services off, Recommendations off, Modeling and Technical support on.
